description: OWASP LLM01 — Prompt Injection: unsanitized user input concatenated into LLM prompt
message: Unsanitized user input flowing into LLM prompt — prompt injection risk (OWASP LLM01)
suggestion: Sanitize and validate user input before passing to LLM. Use input allowlists and output validation

description: OWASP LLM02 — Sensitive Information Disclosure: PII/credentials passed to LLM API
message: Sensitive data (PII/credentials) being sent to LLM API — information disclosure risk (OWASP LLM02)
suggestion: Never pass PII or credentials to LLM APIs. Redact or strip sensitive fields before API calls

description: OWASP LLM05 — Improper Output Handling: raw LLM output rendered as HTML or executed
message: Raw LLM output being rendered as HTML or executed — XSS/code injection risk (OWASP LLM05)
suggestion: Sanitize LLM output before rendering. Use textContent instead of innerHTML, or apply HTML sanitization

description: OWASP LLM06 — Excessive Agency: LLM output used directly for system commands or DB queries
message: LLM output being used for system commands or DB queries — excessive agency risk (OWASP LLM06)
suggestion: Never let LLM output directly execute commands or queries. Validate and sanitize all LLM-generated actions

description: OWASP LLM07 — System Prompt Leakage: secrets embedded in system prompts
message: Secrets detected in LLM system prompt — leakage risk (OWASP LLM07)
suggestion: Never embed credentials in system prompts. Pass secrets through tool functions or env vars instead

description: OWASP LLM10 — Unbounded Consumption: excessive token limits or infinite LLM loops
message: Unbounded LLM token consumption detected — cost and DoS risk (OWASP LLM10)
suggestion: Set reasonable max_tokens limits (e.g., 4096) and add loop termination conditions for LLM calls
